hook_variants: How our team turned a 30-minute founder AMA into 14 days of content.
Case breakdown: The mechanics of zero-waste content production.
body_paragraphs:
Last Tuesday, our team recorded a 30-minute founder AMA.
Here is what happened next:

1. Ingested the audio into IncuBrix Creator Studio
2. Highlighted 4 high-retention stories and deleted tangential rants
3. Exported 4 vertical video clips with burned-in karaoke captions
4. Created 2 LinkedIn carousel summaries
5. Scheduled the posts across LinkedIn and Instagram directly from the dashboard

Total time elapsed: 24 minutes.
Total cost: $0 (using free tier credits).
Stop working harder than your software.
cta: Try the workflow on your next upload at www.incubrix.com
